title: Number of Nicolas Cage films correlates with swimming pool drownings (r = 0.666)
description: The annual count of Nicolas Cage film releases correlated with US swimming pool drowning deaths from 1999–2009 (r = 0.666). A widely shared illustration of the distinction between correlation and causation, and of how any two time series with overlapping trends will yield non-trivial correlation coefficients. Often used in data science onboarding and introductory statistics courses.
